biography:
I help the world’s largest cloud and hyperscale customers solve complex problems at scale.

With 20+ years in enterprise and hyperscale sales — including over a decade at one of the world’s leading data center providers — I’ve built a track record of driving growth, unlocking value, and delivering high-impact solutions across North America, EMEA, and LATAM. I’ve led nine-figure TCV deals, navigated global negotiations across five continents, and served as a trusted advisor to cloud providers, GPU manufacturers, and Fortune 100 companies.

Whether I’m aligning cross-functional teams, accelerating GTM strategies, or simplifying complex infrastructure requirements, I focus on one thing: delivering outcomes that earn trust and drive long-term partnership value.

I'm passionate about the evolving demands of hyperscale, AI, and cloud infrastructure — and always open to connecting with others in the industry to share insights, exchange ideas, or explore new ways to meet our customers’ most ambitious goals.
